user.title: House Rules
user.description: Rules, rooms and settings are edited in the House Rules panel or in house_rules.yaml (both ways).

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Rules is already set up.

yaml_error.title: house_rules.yaml is invalid
yaml_error.description:
{file}, line {line}: {error}

The last valid configuration keeps running. Editing in the panel is paused until the file is fixed.

invalid_rules.title: Some House Rules rules are invalid

keep_on_failed.title: {rule}: {entity} keeps turning off
keep_on_failed.description: {entity} was turned back on too many times in a row: the rule stopped trying. Check the device, then use Cancel on the rule (or the house_rules.cancel action) to try again.

resume_failed.title: {rule}: {entity} could not be resumed
resume_failed.description: The appliance was powered back on too many times during the same programme: the rule stopped trying. Check the appliance, then use Cancel on the rule to try again.

trigger.name: Test a rule
trigger.description: Runs the action of one or more rules once.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Pauses one or more rules for a while (0 or empty: resume now).

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Stops what a rule is doing (alert, timers) or forgets its failures.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Ends the alerts (all of them when no rule is given).

extend_timer.name: Extend timer
extend_timer.description: Adds minutes to the auto-off timer of entities.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reads house_rules.yaml again (the file is also watched).

export_yaml.name: Export as YAML
export_yaml.description: Returns the whole configuration as YAML.
